args: In ndpi/src/lib/protocols/bittorrent.c and ndpi/src/include/ndpi_typedefs.h, what is the intended invariant for accessing flow->protos.bittorrent.hash when TLS is also in detected_protocol_stack? Identify every write/read in bittorrent.c that must be guarded to avoid corrupting or interpreting the shared tls_quic union, and suggest the most consistent existing protocol-stack check.

The reported crash occurs when ndpi_search_bittorrent_hash copies 20 payload bytes into flow->protos.bittorrent.hash on a flow retaining TLS as master, corrupting tls_quic.server_names and causing ndpi_free_flow_data to free a wild pointer. I have observed writes at bittorrent.c lines 98 and 556, and a read at line 115. reader_util already avoids the hash for combined TLS/BitTorrent. I need a root-cause patch that preserves TLS union state and avoids all accesses to the BitTorrent union member in this combined flow state.
